question: Which brackets changed material between revisions? From what to what, and why?
Do 6061 aluminum brackets fail durability (fatigue) testing more often than SPCC brackets? Give the failure rate for each.

Across our parts, what fixes were used for salt spray failures, and how many parts got each kind of fix? Which was most common?
Which released 6061 aluminum bracket is the heaviest, and who supplies it, at what lead time and unit cost?
양산 승인된 6061 알루미늄 브래킷 중 가장 무거운 건 뭐고, 공급사·리드타임·단가는?
Did any part that looks like BR-66254 fail fatigue testing? For the ones that were fixed and are released now, who is the supplier?
BR-66254랑 비슷하게 생긴 부품 중 피로 시험 불합격한 게 있어? 그중 수정돼서 양산 승인된 부품의 공급사는?
Has any fix failed? I mean a part that was revised to fix a failed test but still fails that same test on the new revision.

gold.criterion: Does the answer say yes, and is every part it presents as a failed fix one of the parts in the truth? Naming only some of them is fine; saying none, or naming another part, is not.
gold.reference: Yes, 4 parts: BD-96199 (static: rev A failed, fixed in rev B [ECO-400645], rev B failed again); BM-69546 (static: rev A failed, fixed in rev B [ECO-630599], rev B failed again); BM-57276 (fatigue: rev A failed, fixed in rev B [ECO-918552], rev B failed again); BD-29472 (dimensional: rev A failed, fixed in rev B [ECO-761493], rev B failed again). All were fixed again on the next revision.

question: I'd like to reuse an existing part instead of making BR-66254. Is there anything similar in shape, within 1.5x its size, whose current revision passed fatigue testing?
